semiconductor_relevance: High — TZTEK specializes in high-precision optical metrology and inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry.
summary: TZTEK Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced AI-driven vision equipment, focusing on high-precision optical metrology and inspection solutions for the semiconductor sector. The company enhances quality and efficiency in semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in wafer front-end processes.

regional_presence.China: TZTEK is a pioneer listed on the China STAR Market and serves over 6,000 customers worldwide.
